tweet_pool.author: lukepierceops
tweet_pool.text: Anthropic, Blackstone, and Goldman Sachs officially launched Ode today. A $1.5 billion AI services firm. Forward deployed engineers embed inside enterprise companies, map their operations, and build custom AI systems on top.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete company move: launch of Ode, a $1.5B AI services firm backed by Anthropic, Blackstone and Goldman Sachs.

tweet_pool.author: jason_koebler
tweet_pool.text: Scoop: The AI music generator Suno was hacked. Hacker shared source code that shows how the tool was made and part of the music and podcasts that were scraped to create it.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete reported news: Suno hack exposing source code and scraped training data. High engagement, journalist scoop.

tweet_pool.author: pashmerepat
tweet_pool.text: Absolutely beautiful rant about AI in Linux Kernel from Linus yesterday: Linux is not one of those anti-AI projects.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete policy stance: Linus Torvalds states the Linux kernel is not an anti-AI project. High engagement.

tweet_pool.author: jxmnop
tweet_pool.text: people are underestimating what a big deal this is. this is the ONLY open-weight model that's trained without distilling from OpenAI or Anthropic. Kimi distills, GLM distills, Qwen distills, Nemotron distills.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Strong practitioner analysis on open-weight model training independence. High engagement.

tweet_pool.author: btaylor
tweet_pool.text: I deeply resent that AI has forced me to eliminate em dashes from my writing for fear of signaling slop.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Widely-shared practitioner observation on AI's effect on writing conventions. Very high engagement.

tweet_pool.author: karpathy
tweet_pool.text: It's not just em dashes, it's that many other legitimate & useful language constructs are suddenly and somewhat arbitrarily super awkward and cringe.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Notable practitioner take extending the AI-writing-conventions discussion.

tweet_pool.author: GergelyOrosz
tweet_pool.text: Knowing how LLM contexts work and how to work around context limitations - aka context engineering - is becoming so important.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Useful technical framing on context engineering from a well-known practitioner.
